summary: Small-town weekly page: CLASSIFIEDS in giant heavy serif caps with a drop shadow, centred serif classification heads between rules, justified serif liners each closed by a run code, a Legal Notices block in the same shadowed display serif, and a full-colour college ad across the foot.

frame.masthead: Running head (page, paper, date, town), then full-width heavy Didone/Bodoni Poster caps with a hard offset shadow.

headers.notes: Bold serif title case, centred, hairlines above and below.
Same shadowed poster serif as the masthead, at a smaller size, opening a new section mid-page.
Occasional reversed head in heavy serif caps.

units.notes: Caps lead with a hyphen, run code (issue-week-count) flush right on the last line.
Local business logos and big phone numbers; one $369/mo. display in heavy condensed.

units.example: MORTGAGE SALE - Default has been made...
units.notes: Mortgage sale notices in small justified serif, three columns.

type.look: Bodoni Poster / heavy Didone caps with hard drop shadow

notes: Serif variant of the community weekly; differs from Hood County's sans-and-bars look mainly in type.
